card.name: Acting words in political and policy essays
card.fires_on: Mostly forms of the verb act (acting, act, acted) in opinion or policy writing on law, schools and civil rights. Also fires on scattered linking words and word parts in the same kind of text.

modes.description: The verb act, acting or acted in sentences about legal duties, rights or liability.

modes.description: Small words like or, and, of inside lists or phrases about school discipline and social groups.
